thread:
deploy-bot: Quiet window starting in 10m for edge egress pool re-anchor: edge-pool-eu -> edge-pool-eu-v2. Planned staged shift with sticky-session backfill. Change window 11:00-11:30 UTC. Playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/egress-shift :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ana: Quick question — how are we handling session affinity? cookies or header pin? Also any DB connection drains to be aware of?

mike: We'll rely on cookie-based affinity (rw_session). Plan: set router weight 0->5->20->50->100 with 10m holds between steps. For sessions we do graceful drain at 60s with 503 fallback. No DB schema changes so no connection drain needed.

tyler: Can we start with a 3m canary then evaluate metrics? 5% steady for 3m, then bump. Want to watch tail latency and error rate.

jess: Dashboards ready: router/edge-latency, 95/99p, upstream-5xx-rate, prefix-cache-hit. Alert thresholds in the playbook: p99 > 2200ms OR 5xx > 0.8% for 2m -> auto-pause. I'll watch.

sre-runbook-bot: Pre-checks OK: healthcheck endpoints green, last deploy <24h, infra quotas OK, no open incidents. Runbook snippet:
```
# set initial weight
curl -X POST https://infra-api.local/v1/routes/edge-pool-eu/rollout \
  -d '{"target":"edge-pool-eu-v2","weight":5}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_API'
```

ops-liaison: Noting change window and pager rotation. @oncall-sre will be primary pager, @platform-eng on standby.

mike: Step commands for shift and rollback:
- shift: `infractl router set-weight edge-pool-eu edge-pool-eu-v2 5` (repeat for 20,50,100)
- pause: `infractl router pause-rollout edge-pool-eu`
- rollback: `infractl router set-weight edge-pool-eu edge-pool-eu-v2 0` then set weight back to original pool 100

ana: Can we pin certain VIPs to stay on v1 (long-lived streaming sessions)? If so I'd like two VIPs excluded from shift.

mike: Yes — create an exclusion rule on router: `infractl router add-exclusion edge-pool-eu vip-12345`. I'll add it before the 5% step.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: weight -> 5%. Observers: @jess @tyler @ana. Live link: https://infra-monitor.local/rollouts/1850004321 :rocket:

jess: Seeing a small p95 bump on region-eu-north, not yet at alert. p99 stable. Continuing to monitor.

mike: Observability note — we're seeing higher connection handshake on v2 nodes. Increasing keepalive to reduce churn.

tyler: Can we hold at 5% for another 10m to confirm? I vote hold.

ana: Agree, hold. Pausing automated schedule.

mike: Pausing now. Running `infractl router pause-rollout edge-pool-eu` -> OK.

sre-runbook-bot: Auto-pause reason: manual pause requested by tyler.

jess: While paused, p95 trending down. p99 steady. No increase in 5xx. Good to proceed after hold.

mike: Given the transient handshake spike and to be conservative we will abort the shift and roll back to v1 for full traffic while we investigate. Executing rollback: `infractl router set-weight edge-pool-eu edge-pool-eu-v2 0` -> OK.

deploy-bot: Rollback executed at 1850004602, target weight 0%. All traffic restored to edge-pool-eu (v1).

ops-liaison: Noted. Opening follow-up ticket to root-cause handshake spike and coordination with infra-team. Ticket: RW-#4521.

ana: Thanks team. Postmortem requested if root cause > 30m impact. Otherwise short RCA in RW-#4521.

mike: I'll attach logs and kernel-level metrics. Planning a reattempt after infra tweaks next week.

jess: I'll keep dashboards with baseline screenshots. If anyone wants the timeline CSV I can upload.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by deploy-bot. If reattempt scheduled, start a fresh rollout thread with new timestamp. :white_check_mark:
